notes: Added missing schema/contract, API exposure, testing, and integration coverage for explainability layer.

EVAL-F5-S14.title: Explainability Schema Contract Definition
EVAL-F5-S14.description: Define a standardized explainability schema (source, meaning, limitations, confidence if applicable) and enforce it via Pydantic models to ensure all evaluation signals produce consistent explainability objects.

EVAL-F5-S15.title: Explainability API Exposure via Facade
EVAL-F5-S15.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to attach standardized explainability objects to all evaluation responses and ensure they are included in tool outputs returned to the chat layer.

EVAL-F5-S16.title: Explainability Unit and Integration Tests
EVAL-F5-S16.description: Create unit tests for explainability schema validation and normalization logic, plus integration tests ensuring explainability content is correctly generated and returned for provider and clinical trial flows.

EVAL-F5-S17.title: End-to-End Integration with Evaluation Signals
EVAL-F5-S17.description: Integrate explainability layer across provider credentials, external links, and clinical trials so that every surfaced signal includes a complete explainability object without breaking existing response formats.
